blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
blocks.zh: 定量研究是一个迭代循环:研究者提出市场假说,作为可执行信号执行,在历史数据上测试,并决定保存什么. 现有基准计分公式,代码,或单个交易决定,对于大语言模型(LLMS)能否完成这个循环,产生超过研究期有效的策略,则留有开口. 我们引入了"Quant-Arena",这是对真实的A-share市场数据进行端到端定量研究的基准和公共领导板. 一个模型构建了特征和股票评分代码,只在2022-2023年接收回馈,并冻结了被封存的2024年的一个评估策略. 现金账户评估员采用交易限制和成本,包括模拟订货簿估计的市场影响。 分数以实际的超额回报为主,并以信号质量和该战略所用特性的多样性为补充。 我们评价了9个前沿模型,其中GPT-6 Astra的得分最高;然而,2024年没有任何模型能比同量市场强. Quant-Arena可接受任何模型或代理设备的提交。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Quantitative research turns hypotheses about market behavior into executable trading strategies. Researchers construct features from market observations, combine them into predictive factors or signals, and use those signals to build and test portfolios. Large language models (LLMs) are a natural fit for this research loop: they can propose hypotheses, implement them in code, interpret feedback, and revise their approach. Recent systems already explore this potential through interactive alpha discovery and iterative factor search ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 定量研究将市场行为的假设转化为可执行的交易策略. 研究人员从市场观测中构建特征,将它们结合到预测因素或信号中,并利用这些信号构建和测试组合. 大型语言模型(LLMs)是这种研究循环的自然适合:它们可以提出假设,在代码中执行,解释反馈,修改方法. 最近的系统已经通过交互α发现和迭代因子搜索来探索这种潜力(Wang等人,2023年;Tang等人,2025年;Han等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks measure different parts of this workflow. AlphaQT-Bench evaluates the correctness of quantitative trading code, while AlphaBench studies the generation, evaluation, and search of formulaic factors ( AlphaQT-Bench, ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . StockBench evaluates agents that make sequential trading decisions from market information ( StockBench, ) . AlphaForgeBench extends evaluation to generating factor and strategy code from natural-language objectives and backtesting it on historical daily market data ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
To our knowledge, this is the first benchmark on real market data in which models construct features from raw order and trade records, revise their signals using bounded feedback, and submit a frozen strategy for out-of-sample assessment under common trading rules. This setting evaluates feature construction, signal combination, and strategy selection through their joint effect on the final portfolio.
blocks.zh:
现有基准衡量这一工作流程的不同部分。 AlphaQT-Bench评价定量交易代码的正确性,而Alpha Bench则研究公式因子的生成,评价和搜索(AlphaQT-Bench, ; Roo等人, 2026). Stock Bench评价根据市场信息(Stock Bench, )作出连续交易决定的代理商。 AlphaForge Bench 将评价扩展到从自然语言目标生成因子和战略代码,并在历史的日常市场数据上进行回溯测试(Zhang等人,2026年).
据我们所知,这是关于实际市场数据的第一个基准,其中模型从原始秩序和贸易记录中构建特征,利用有限度的反馈修改其信号,并提交根据共同贸易规则进行抽样评估的冻结战略。 这种设置通过对最终投资组合的共同影响来评价构造、信号组合和战略选择。

blocks.en: We introduce Quant-Arena , a benchmark for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data (Figure 2 ). At the input end, model-generated Python programs access raw Level-2 records, including individual orders and trades and order-book snapshots, through a controlled data interface. Models determine which features to construct and how to combine them into daily stock scores. During research, they can evaluate candidate strategies on 2022–2023, inspect the permitted feedback, and revise their code within a fixed budget. Each run then commits one frozen strategy. At the output end, the platform executes that strategy on the sealed year 2024 and measures the portfolio’s returns after trading costs.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 Quant-Arena , 一个关于真实的 A-share 市场数据(图2)的端到端定量研究的基准。 在输入端,模型生成的Python程序通过一个可控数据接口访问原始的Level-2记录,包括单个订单和交易以及订单-书快照. 模型决定了哪些特征可以构建,以及如何将它们结合到日库存分数中. 在研究期间,他们可以在2022-2023年评价候选战略,检查允许的反馈,并在固定预算范围内修改其守则. 每一次跑步都执行一个冻结策略 在产出端,该平台在封存的2024年执行该战略,并衡量投资组合在交易成本后的收益。

blocks.en: Quant-Arena applies common portfolio and execution rules to make these outcomes comparable. Daily scores determine an equal-weight portfolio of the highest-ranked stocks, and a cash-account evaluator applies lot-size constraints and order-dependent costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Out-of-sample return and excess return over the market provide direct measures of profitability. Risk and signal statistics and the diversity of features used by the strategy provide complementary views of the result. Together, these measurements distinguish finding a predictive signal from turning it into a profitable portfolio.
blocks.zh: Quant-Arena采用共同的投资组合和执行规则使这些结果具有可比性。 每日得分决定了排名最高的股票的等量投资组合,现金账户评价员采用批量大小的限制和依赖订单的成本,包括从模拟订单簿中估计的市场影响. 超标回报和超标回报直接衡量盈利能力. 风险和信号统计以及该战略使用的各种特征提供了对结果的补充看法。 这些测量方法共同区分了寻找预测信号与将其转化为盈利组合.

blocks.en: A common research budget controls how much search each run can undertake. Repeated backtests favor candidates that fit historical noise ( Bailey et al., 2017 ) , so the selected strategy must be assessed on data that its research never observed. The platform also records candidate evaluations and final submissions. These records allow us to examine how models use feedback and select strategies alongside their eventual financial outcomes.
blocks.zh: 共同的研究预算可以控制每个运行可以进行多少搜索. 重复的反验偏好符合历史噪声的考生(Bailey等人,2017年),因此所选择的战略必须根据其研究从未观察到的数据进行评估. 该平台还记录候选人评价和最后呈件。 这些记录使我们能够审查模型如何利用反馈和选择战略以及最终的财务结果。

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • An end-to-end quantitative research benchmark. Quant-Arena connects feature and signal construction from real market events to the out-of-sample performance of an executable strategy, making the complete research run the unit of evaluation. • A common research and financial evaluation protocol. A bounded research process, frozen strategy submission, and sealed assessment under shared portfolio and trading rules support comparisons of profitability, risk, signal quality, and feature diversity. • An empirical analysis of LLM quantitative research. We evaluate nine frontier models. No model beats the equal-weight market in 2024: the stocks a model ranks highest typically underperform the market average. The strongest model gains mainly by learning when to stay out of the market rather than by selecting better stocks. • A public evaluation platform. Quant-Arena is released as a public arena that accepts submissions from any model or agent harness under the same protocol and sealed assessment.
blocks.zh: • 支助 端对端定量研究基准. Quant-Arena将从真实的市场事件到一个可执行策略的外显性能的特征和信号构建连接起来,使得完整的研究运行着评价单位. • 共同研究和财务评价协议。 • 根据共同投资组合和交易规则进行有限度的研究进程、冻结的战略提交和密封评估,有助于比较利润率、风险、信号质量和特征多样性。 LLM定量研究经验分析. 我们评价9个前沿模型 2024年没有模特儿胜过等重市场:一个模特儿的股票排名最高,一般低于市场平均水平. 最强模型主要通过学会何时远离市场,而不是选择更好的股票而获得收益. • 公共评价平台。 Quant-Arena作为公共舞台发布,接受任何模型或代理设备根据同一协议提交的信息并进行密封评估。

blocks.en: 2.2 Market Data and Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 市场数据和基准建设

blocks.en: We use real market observations from a fixed data release, stock universe, and trading calendar. Models construct features from the raw inputs without a predefined factor library. Missing observations and delisted stocks are retained without redefining daily universe membership.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个固定数据发布、股票宇宙和交易日历 的市场观察结果 模型从原始输入中构造特性,没有预先定义的因子库. 缺失的观测和已除名的种群在保留时没有重新界定日常成员。

blocks.en: Table 1: Market data and temporal split used by the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表1:基准使用的市场数据和时间划分。

blocks.en: The data interface restricts access by date, instrument, and field. At each decision date, the strategy can access authorized historical observations, including permitted warmup history. The same input definitions and access rules apply during research and assessment.
blocks.zh: 数据接口按日期、仪器和字段限制访问。 在每一决定日期,该战略都可以查阅经授权的历史观察,包括允许的暖和历史。 同样的投入定义和获取规则适用于研究和评估。

blocks.en: 2.3 Research and Assessment Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.3 研究和评估议定书

blocks.en: Models may evaluate candidate strategies on the research period and revise their code using aggregate return, signal-quality and coverage statistics, and execution errors. Each run may evaluate at most five candidates on the research period. Participants may define training and validation splits within the research period; the benchmark prescribes no separate training window.
blocks.zh: 模型可以评价研究期间的候选战略,并使用总回报、信号质量和覆盖范围统计以及执行错误来修改其代码。 每一次竞选最多可评选五个研究期的候选人。 参与者可在研究期间确定培训和鉴定的划分;基准没有规定单独的培训窗口。

blocks.en: At the end of research, one strategy’s source code, execution environment, and declared features are frozen. The evaluator applies this strategy once to the sealed out-of-sample period. The strategy accesses the observations needed for execution through the authorized data interface. Neither these observations nor assessment feedback is returned to the model for further development.
blocks.zh: 在研究结束时,一个策略的源代码,执行环境和宣布的特征被冻结. 评价人员将这一战略适用于密封的采样期。 该战略通过授权的数据接口获取执行所需的观测结果。 这些意见或评估反馈均不退回模型供进一步发展。

blocks.en: 2.4 Financial Evaluation and Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.4 财务评价和计量

blocks.en: The evaluator converts stock rankings into an equal-weight long portfolio targeting 75 stocks. The backtest maintains a cash account with 100-share lots, order-dependent trading costs, and market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Idle cash earns zero return, and daily net asset value includes cash and outstanding positions. Account returns are compounded over each evaluation period.
blocks.zh: 评价员将股票排名转换为以75种股票为目标的等重长投资组合。 后置测试员维持一个现金账户,有100份额的批量,依赖订单的交易成本,以及模拟订单簿估计的市场影响. 闲置现金获得零回报,每日净资产价值包括现金和未清头寸。 每个评价期间的账户回报都比较复杂。

blocks.en: We report out-of-sample annualized return and excess return over a full-market equal-weight reference aligned to the same trading days. The reference is gross of costs. Long-only Sharpe ( SR L \mathrm{SR}_{\mathrm{L}} ) measures risk-adjusted performance, and maximum drawdown measures downside risk. Signal metrics include mean daily RankIC, its annualized information ratio ( A A ), long–short Sharpe ( SR LS \mathrm{SR}_{\mathrm{LS}} ) between the highest- and lowest-scored deciles, and turnover, the average daily replacement fraction of the portfolio. Daily RankIC is the rank correlation between stock scores and next-period returns; A A is its mean divided by its standard deviation, multiplied by N ann \sqrt{N_{\mathrm{ann}}} , where N ann N_{\mathrm{ann}} denotes the number of trading days per year used for annualization.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Our experiments address five questions. To evaluate how far current models are from a strong research agent, and how reasoning effort changes this, we compare 38 iterative configurations of nine models (Section 3.2 ). To evaluate why predictive skill does not become profit, we analyze next-day returns by signal decile (Section 3.3 ). To evaluate whether any strategy adapts to the market regime, we trace Astra’s account and exposure (Section 3.4 ). To evaluate what iteration contributes, we pair iterative and one-shot runs and follow candidates through the research period (Section 3.5 ). To evaluate whether models share a trading style, we measure their holding exposures (Section 3.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及五个问题。 为了评价当前模型与强力研究代理人的距离有多远,以及推理努力如何改变这一点,我们比较了38个9个模型的迭代配置(第3.2节). 为了评估预测技能为何不能成为利润,我们用信号十进制分析第二天的回报(第3.3节)。 为了评估任何战略是否适应市场制度,我们追踪Astra的账户和风险(第3.4节)。 为了评价迭代的贡献,我们在研究期间将迭代和一弹一弹进行并跟踪候选人(第3.5节)。 为了评价模型是否具有交易风格,我们衡量其持有量(第3.6节)。

blocks.en: We run Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3 in the iterative and one-shot settings at every reasoning effort they support: six levels for Terra, five for Opus, Sonnet, Astra, and Sol, four for DeepSeek, three for Gemini and Kimi, and two for GLM. This gives 38 iterative and 38 one-shot configurations. The one-shot results are in Appendix B . We report the total score S S with its research-period and sealed-period components, and for the sealed 2024 window the annualized return (ARR), excess ARR over the gross equal-weight market, mean RankIC, long-only Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown. The diagnostics in Sections 3.3 – 3.6 use, for each model, the iterative configuration with the highest total score (the shaded rows of Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们运行 Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, 双子座 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,Kimi K3,以及GLM-5.3在他们支持的每一个推理努力的迭代和一拍设置中:Terra的六级,Opus的五级,Sonnet,Astra和Sol的四级,DeepSeek的四级,双子座和Kimi的三级,GLM的两级. 这给出了38个迭代和38个一拍配置. 一发结果载于附录B。 我们报告SS总分及其研究期和封存期的成分,对于封存的2024窗口,则报告年度化回报(ARR),超额ARR超过总等重市场,平均RankIC,长效Sharpe比,以及最大缩减。 第3.3–3.6节中的诊断对每个模型都使用总分最高的迭代配置(表2的阴影行).

blocks.en: 3.2 Performance Across Models and Reasoning Efforts
blocks.zh: 3.2 各种模式的业绩和理性努力

blocks.en: Table 2 : Iterative results for every model and supported reasoning effort, Models are ordered by their best total score, and efforts increase within each model. Shaded rows mark each model’s highest-scoring effort, the configuration used by the diagnostics in Sections 3.3 – 3.6 . Scores are on a 0–100 scale. Financial and signal metrics refer to the sealed 2024 window; the gross equal-weight market ARR is 17.1%. MDD is a negative return. Bold marks the best value in each column.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个模型和辅助推理努力的迭代结果,模型按其最佳总分排序,每个模型内的努力增加. 每个模型的分数最高,是第3.3–3.6节诊断者使用的配置。 得分为0-100。 财务和信号计量指封存的2024窗口;总等重市场ARR为17.1%. MDD是一种负回报. 粗体标出每列中的最佳值.

blocks.en: Profitable strategies are rare, and only one beats the market. Thirteen of the 38 configurations earn positive ARR, and the only one above the 17.1% market is Sol at medium effort (18.4%, + 1.4 +1.4 pp). Most strategies keep under half of their capital in stocks (mean exposure 34–48% in 35 of the 38 runs), so they pay trading costs while capturing only part of the market’s gain.
blocks.zh: 实用的策略很少见,只有一种胜过市场. 在38个配置中,有13个获得积极的ARR,而17.1%以上的市场只有Sol中度努力(18.4%,+1.4+1.4页)。 大部分策略都把资本的一半用于股票(平均风险为34-48 % , 在38个交易中的35个),因此它们支付交易成本,而只获得部分市场收益。

blocks.en: Higher reasoning effort does not reliably raise the score. For six of the nine models the best effort is not the highest one supported (Table 2 ): Opus scores 44.28 at medium against 41.39 at max, Gemini 43.04 against 35.39, and Kimi 38.31 at low against 31.86 at max. Only Sonnet, Terra, and GLM peak at their highest effort. The range across a model’s efforts reaches 14.49 points (Terra), close to the 18.77-point range between the nine highest-effort scores. Effort acts through discrete design choices rather than gradual improvement. Astra’s xhigh and max runs add a market-state filter and hold cash on 70–75% of days, while its low, medium, and high runs stay about 47–48% invested, and its score jumps from 43.70 at high to 51.29 at xhigh. Sol follows the same pattern: its xhigh run is 5% invested on average against 34–46% at its other efforts.
blocks.zh: 更高的推理努力并不能可靠地提高分数. 在9个模式中,有6个模式的最佳努力不是得到支持的最高努力(表2)。 Opus中分44.28分,最高分41.39分,双子座43.04分,最低分35.39分,基米38.31分,最高分31.86分. 只有Sonnet,Terra,和GLM 在他们最高的努力。 一个模型的努力范围达到14.49分(特拉),接近9个最高得分之间的18.77分。 通过离散的设计选择而不是逐步改进来努力行动。 阿斯特拉的x高和最大运行增加了市场状态过滤器,在70–75天的时间里持有现金,而其低,中,高运行则保持约47–48 % 的投资,其得分从43–70高跃升至51–29高. 索尔遵循同样的模式:其x高运行率平均投资5%,而在其他努力中则为34-46%。

blocks.en: 3.3 Why Models Fall Short: Ranking Skill Does Not Reach the Portfolio
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 为什么模特儿短短:排名技能没有到达组合

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Mean next-day return by daily score decile for the nine models’ best iterative configurations in 2024, in basis points (bp). H–L is the highest-minus-lowest decile spread, and the last entry in each header is the number of days with a signal.
blocks.zh: 图3: 2024年9个模型最佳迭代配置的下日平均得分十分数回报率,以基点(bp)表示. H-L是最小十进制传播率最高的,每个标题中最后一个条目是带有信号的天数.

blocks.en: Models rank stocks with some skill, but the stocks they buy are not the ones that earn the most. Opus, Sonnet, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM show a hump (Figure 3 ): the second or third decile earns the most, 24–33 bp per day, and returns fall toward the top decile, so H–L lies between − 10.5 -10.5 and + 4.7 +4.7 bp. Terra and Astra rise across deciles ( + 28.6 +28.6 and + 38.7 +38.7 bp), and Sol is flat. Average rank correlation does not predict profit: GLM has RankIC 0.046 and ARR − 7.8 % -7.8\% , while Opus at medium effort has RankIC − 0.002 -0.002 and ARR 4.4%, and across the 38 iterative runs the two are almost uncorrelated (Spearman 0.09). RankIC averages over the whole cross-section, but the portfolio holds only the 75 top-ranked stocks, and for most models that is where the decile profile declines.
blocks.zh: 模特儿会给股票打分 但他们买的股票不是收入最高的 Opus、Sonnet、双子座、DeepSeek、Kimi和GLM显示一个峰值(图3):第二个或第三个十进制收入最高,每天24-33 bp,返回率下降至顶级十进制,因此H-L位于−10.5-10.5和+4.7+4.7 bp之间。 Terra和Astra跨越十进制(+28.6+28.6和+38.7+38.7 bp)上升,Sol是平的。 平均军衔相关性不预测利润:GLM有RankIC 0.046和ARR − 7.8% - 7.8\%;而Opus在中等努力中则有RankIC − 0.002 - 0.002和ARR 4.4%,在38次迭代运行中,两者几乎无关(Spearman 0.09)。 RankIC在整个横截面上的平均值,但投资组合只持有75个排名最高的股票,对于大多数模型来说,这是十进制配置下降的地方.

blocks.en: 3.4 Case Study: Astra Learns Market Timing
blocks.zh: 3.4 案例研究:Astra学习市场时机

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Cash-account NAV of the iterative Astra run at xhigh effort in 2024, against the gross equal-weight market. Shaded bands mark days on which Astra holds stocks.
blocks.zh: 图4:现金账户 迭代Astra的NAV在2024年以x高强度的努力对阵总的等重市场. 阿斯特拉持有股票的日子

blocks.en: Astra’s lead comes from staying out of the market, not from choosing better stocks. Its program scores stocks only when the median five-session and twenty-session log returns of the universe are both positive, and holds cash otherwise. The first three candidates have no such rule. It appears in the fourth and fifth submissions, the fifth being the committed strategy, after research feedback showed net losses in both research years ( − 12.2 % -12.2\% in 2022 and − 13.6 % -13.6\% in 2023). The rule keeps Astra out of the early-2024 decline (Figure 4 ): it first buys stocks on 28 February, its NAV is exactly 1.000 when the market bottoms at 0.704 on 6 February, and its maximum drawdown over January and February is − 1.7 % -1.7\% against − 29.6 % -29.6\% for the market. Over the year, Astra ends at 1.107 against 1.170 for the market, − 6.3 -6.3 pp of excess return, and 12.5% of its gain arrives in the five sessions from 24 to 30 September. Cash on 75% of trading days caps participation: Astra captures 16% of the market’s rebound from the February low, against 73% for Terra, so the lower drawdown comes with a lower upside. The behavior depends on effort: Astra’s low, medium, and high runs are invested on nearly every day and suffer drawdowns of − 25.7 % -25.7\% , − 17.9 % -17.9\% , and − 26.3 % -26.3\% .
blocks.zh: Astra的领先地位来自远离市场, 其程序只有在宇宙中位数的五会话和二十会话日志回报为正数时才得分,否则则持有现金. 前三名候选人没有这种规则。 它出现在第四和第五次提交材料中,第五份是承诺的战略,在研究反馈显示两个研究年份的净损失(2022年为12.2%-12.2%,2023年为13.6%-13.6%)。 该规则使Astra避免了2024年初的衰退(图4):它于2月28日首次购买股票,其NAV在2月6日市场底盘为0.704时正好是1000美元,1月和2月的最大提款量为1.7 % -1.7\%,而市场为29.6% - 29.6\%. 在这一年中,Astra以1.107对1.170结束市场,6.3至6.3页的超额回报,其收益的12.5%在9月24日至30日的五次会议上到达。 75%交易日的现金限制参与: Astra从2月的低点获取了16%的市场反弹, 而Terra的反弹为73%, 其行为取决于努力:Astra的低、中、高运行率几乎每天投资,并出现 — 25.7% - 25.7 — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — —

blocks.en: 3.5 Iteration Raises Scores More Reliably Than Returns
blocks.zh: 3.5 迭代提高分数更可靠 相对于回返

blocks.en: Table 3 : Paired iterative and one-shot results, each at the supported effort with the highest total score within its setting (efforts listed as iterative / one-shot). Δ \Delta is iterative minus one-shot. S in S_{\mathrm{in}} and S out S_{\mathrm{out}} are the research-period and sealed-period scores, and ARR differences are in percentage points. The gross equal-weight market ARR is 17.1%.
blocks.zh: 表3:Paired迭代和一拍结果,每个结果在所支持的努力中,总分在其设定中最高(成绩列为迭代/一拍). \Delta是迭代减一发。 S in S_{\ mathrm{in}和Sout S_{\ mathrm{out}是研究期和封存期的得分,ARR的差别在于百分点. 相同重量的总市场价值为17.1%。

blocks.en: Iteration raises the score for every model but the return for only four. Pairing each model’s best iterative and one-shot configurations (Table 3 ), the mean score rises from 36.47 to 43.55, with gains from 0.69 (Sonnet) to 18.99 (Sol). ARR is higher in the iterative run for Sol, Astra, Kimi, and DeepSeek (by 6.2 to 16.2 pp) and lower for the other five, so the mean gain is only 2.9 pp. Feedback improves the research window more than the sealed year: the mean gain in S in S_{\mathrm{in}} is 10.36 points against 5.67 in S out S_{\mathrm{out}} , and the iterative best configurations lose 12.4 points between the two windows against 7.7 for one-shot. Part of what iteration learns is specific to 2022–2023.
blocks.zh: 迭代提高每个模型的分数,但只有四个的回报. 为每个模型最好的迭代和一发配置配对(表3),平均分从36.47升至43.55,增益从0.69(索内特)升至18.99(索尔). 在Sol,Astra,Kimi和DeepSeek的迭代运行中,ARR较高(比6.2-16.2pp),其他5人则较低,因此平均收益只有2.9pp. 反馈比封存的年份改善了研究窗口:S_{\mathrm{in}}}的S平均收益为10.36分,而S outout S_{\mathrm{out}}}的5.67分,迭代最佳配置在两个窗口之间损失12.4分,一发7.7分. 部分迭代学是2022–2023年特有的.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Research-period progress of the nine iterative runs. (a) Best-so-far excess ARR gain over the first valid candidate; means use the runs available at each index. (b) First, best, and committed candidates on 2022–2023.
blocks.zh: 图5:九次迭代周期研究进展。 (a) 超过第一个有效候选人的最短距离的ARR增益;是指使用每个指数上可用的运行量。 (b) 第一,最佳和有献身精神的候选人在2022-2023年。

blocks.en: Most research progress comes from repairing a weak first candidate. Mean best-so-far gains at valid-candidate indices one to five are 0, 14.4, 16.7, 29.1, and 36.5 pp over 9, 9, 7, 4, and 3 runs (Figure 5 ), but the median gain is 6.5 pp at the second candidate and 7.0 pp at the end of the run. Two runs drive the mean: DeepSeek and Sol improve by 57.1 and 50.7 pp from first candidates near − 44 -44 and − 45 -45 pp excess ARR, and without them the mean final gain is 6.5 pp. The second candidate is the research-period best in four of nine runs, and three runs commit their best candidate. Large gains come from fixing a clear error in a poor first candidate, and once candidates are near break-even, further evaluations add only a few points.
blocks.zh: 研究进展大多来自修复弱的第一候选人. 在有效候选人指数1至5下,平均最高收益为0、14.4、16.7、29.1和36.5页,超过9、9、7、4和3(图5),但第二候选人的中位收益为6.5页,最后为7.0页。 两次赛跑都带动了中间点:DeepSeek和Sol从接近-44-44和-45-45 pp的初选者中提升了57.1和50.7pp,超标的ARR,没有它们,平均最终收益是6.5pp. 第二名候选人是9次竞选中4次获得最佳研究期,3次竞选承诺了最佳候选人. 确定一个贫穷的第一候选人的明显错误可产生很大收益,一旦候选人接近平衡,进一步评价只增加几分。

blocks.en: 3.6 Trading Styles
blocks.zh: 3.6 交易样式

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Holding-value-weighted style exposure of the nine models’ best iterative configurations in 2024, in cross-sectional standard deviations relative to the market. Astra’s estimates use its 61 invested days.
blocks.zh: 图6 2024年9个型号最佳迭代配置的控股值加权样式曝光,与市场相对的跨区标准差. Astra的估计用的是61个投资日。

blocks.en: Most models converge on small-cap, low-volatility, value-tilted holdings, and style does not separate winners from losers. Eight of nine models tilt toward smaller stocks, seven toward higher book-to-price, and most toward lower volatility and turnover (Figure 6 ). Opus and DeepSeek are the exceptions, leaning toward higher volatility ( + 0.54 +0.54 and + 0.46 +0.46 ) and turnover ( + 0.56 +0.56 and + 0.57 +0.57 ), and Terra stays within 0.11 of the market on every dimension. Earnings-to-price is negative for six models, so the value tilt comes from book value rather than earnings. Similar tilts end in different places: Astra (book-to-price + 0.96 +0.96 , volatility − 1.05 -1.05 ) finishes at 1.11 and Sonnet ( + 0.54 +0.54 , − 0.64 -0.64 ) at 0.88. Account outcomes are set by market exposure and by the head of each ranking, as the previous sections show, and the style tilt adds little to them.
blocks.zh: 大多数模型都集中在小额,低挥发性,价值倾斜的控股上,风格并不将赢家和输家分开. 9种模式中有8种向较小的股票倾斜,7种向较高的账面对价倾斜,大多数向较低的波动和营业额倾斜(图6)。 Opus和DeepSeek是例外,倾向于更高的波动性(+0.54+0.54和+0.46+0.46)和营业额(+0.56+0.56和+0.57+0.57),Terra在每个维度上停留在市场0.11范围内. 收入对价格对6种模型是负的,所以价值倾斜来自账面价值而不是收益. 类似倾斜在不同地点结束: Astra(书对价+0.96+0.96,波动−1.05-1.05)在1.11和Sonnet(+0.54+0.54,−0.64)在0.88完成. 如前几节所示,账户结果由市场曝光和每个排名的主管来设定,风格倾斜对它们没有多大增加.

blocks.en: 3.7 Kepler-1 Against the Models
blocks.zh: 3.7 开普勒-1 反对模式

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Cash-account NAV in 2024 for the nine models’ best iterative configurations and Kepler-1, against the gross equal-weight market.
blocks.zh: 图7:2024年9种型号最佳迭代配置和开普勒-1对总等重市场的现金账户NAV.

blocks.en: Kepler-1 turns its edge into account value, while the best model barely finishes above its starting capital. Kepler-1 scores 77.56 and ends 2024 at 1.93 against 1.17 for the market (Figure 7 ), and four models finish above their starting capital: Astra (1.11), Sol (1.09), Terra (1.08), and Opus (1.04). The other five end between 0.88 (Sonnet) and 0.97 (Gemini). The lead does not come from a better average rank signal: Kepler-1’s RankIC of 0.085 is below Astra’s 0.101. It comes from converting signal into return, with a Sharpe ratio of 2.98 against 1.89 for the best model.
blocks.zh: 开普勒-1将它的边缘变为了记账价值,而最好的模型几乎完成不了它的起始资本. 开普勒-1得分77.56分,以1.93对1.17的市场成绩结束2024年(图7),四个型号完成时都高于其起始资本:Astra(1.11),Sol(1.09),Terra(1.08)和Opus(1.04). 另外五端介于0.88(索内特)至0.97(热米尼)之间. 领先并不来自更好的平均排名信号:开普勒-1的RankIC 0.085低于Astra的0.101. 它来自将信号转换成返回,最佳型号的夏普比为2.98比1.89.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: 4.1 Formulaic Alpha Mining with Language Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 使用语言模型的公式化阿尔法采矿

blocks.en: Formulaic alpha mining searches for executable expressions that transform market observations into predictive cross-sectional signals. Published formula libraries demonstrate the interpretability and deployability of this representation ( Kakushadze, 2016 ) . Automated approaches then use evolutionary search or learned generators to explore expression spaces and combine the resulting factors ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) . These explicit search spaces support reproducible execution, but they are combinatorial, highly exposed to noisy backtest feedback, and often optimized around a narrow factor statistic rather than the behavior of the final portfolio.
blocks.zh: 公式化α挖掘搜索可执行表达式,将市场观测结果转化为预测的跨部门信号. 已出版的公式库显示了这一表述的可解释性和可部署性(Kakushadze,2016年)。 自动化方法然后使用进化搜索或学习的生成器来探索表达空间,并结合由此产生的因素(张等人,2020年;史等人,2024年). 这些明确的搜索空间支持可复制的执行,但它们是组合式的,高度暴露在吵闹的反测试反馈中,并经常围绕一个狭窄的因素统计而不是最终组合的行为来优化.

blocks.en: LLMs extend this paradigm by connecting economic hypotheses, symbolic construction, and empirical diagnosis. LLMFactor uses sequential knowledge-guided prompting to extract interpretable factors from financial information ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; Automate Strategy Finding with LLM combines multimodal market inputs with a multi-agent portfolio workflow ( Kou et al., 2024 ) ; Alpha-GPT introduces interactive LLM-based alpha generation ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; AlphaAgent regularizes generation for originality, hypothesis–factor alignment, and structural simplicity ( Tang et al., 2025 ) ; and QuantaAlpha treats a complete mining trajectory as the unit of evolution and reuses effective sub-trajectories through mutation and crossover ( Han et al., 2026 ) . These systems establish the value of structured, multi-stage alpha discovery beyond one-shot formula generation. Quant-Arena provides a common protocol for evaluating the resulting model runs with executable strategy outputs and a frozen final-assessment boundary.
blocks.zh: LLMS通过连接经济假设,符号构建,以及经验诊断来扩展这一范式. LLM 语言 要素采用相继的知识引导,从财务信息中提取可解释因素(Wang等人,2024年); 自动战略发现与LLM结合了多种模式市场投入与多剂组合工作流程(Kou等人,2024年); Alpha-GPT引入了基于LM的交互式α生成(Wang等人,2023年); AlphaAAgent规范生成,用于原生性、假说-因子配对和结构简单(Tang等人,2025年); QuantaAlpha将完整的采矿轨迹作为通过突变和交叉进行演化和再利用的有效子电流的单位(Han等人,2026年)。 这些系统确立了结构化,多阶段的α发现的价值,超越了一发式生成. Quant-Arena为评价所产生的模型提供了共同协议,其中包含可执行的战略产出和冻结的最后评估边界。

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: Existing financial infrastructure serves several different evaluation goals. Qlib standardizes AI-oriented quantitative workflows, while FinRL provides reproducible reinforcement-learning environments and trading evaluations ( Yang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ) . Financial language benchmarks such as FinBen and Finance Agent Benchmark evaluate domain understanding, generation, forecasting, and real-world research tasks ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ) ; general agent benchmarks such as AgentBench and MLAgentBench evaluate multi-turn interaction, tool use, and iterative experimentation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) . AlphaBench focuses specifically on formulaic alpha generation, evaluation, and search tasks ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , while AlphaForgeBench targets reproducible end-to-end factor and strategy design with LLMs ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Recent trading-agent evaluation also emphasizes leakage control, attribution, and memory effects in historical markets ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有的金融基础设施为若干不同的评价目标服务。 Qlib将面向AI的定量工作流程标准化,FinRL则提供可复制的强化学习环境和交易评价(杨等人,2020年;刘等人,2020年). Fin Ben和财务代理基准等金融语言基准评价域理解、生成、预测和现实世界研究任务(Xie等人,2024年;Bigeard等人,2025年);Agent Bench和MLAgent Bench等一般代理基准评价多回合互动、工具使用和迭代实验(Liu等人,2023年;Huang等人,2023年)。 Alpha Bench专门专注于公式α生成,评价,和搜索任务(Luo等人,2026年),而AlphaForge Bench的目标是可复制的端对端因子和与LLMs(张等人,2026年)的战略设计. 最近的交易代理评价还强调了历史市场上的渗漏控制、归属和记忆效应(Zhu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: These benchmarks also differ in their unit of evaluation. AlphaQT-Bench ( AlphaQT-Bench, ) treats executability, causal safety, functional correctness, and structural compliance as distinct code-level outcomes, with a small number of repair rounds. StockBench ( StockBench, ) evaluates repeated sequential decisions on a small stock universe and reports passive-hold references, whereas QuantBench ( QuantBench, ) studies conventional quantitative models, feature sets, and training seeds rather than LLM research systems. AlphaForgeBench expands the number of generated implementations through many short tasks, and KTD-Fin separates trading-agent behavior from information access and attribution. These designs motivate reporting execution status, financial outcomes, and information boundaries.
blocks.zh: 这些基准的评价单位也各不相同。 AlphaQT-Bench(AlphaQT-Bench, )将可执行性,因果安全性,功能正确性,结构合规性作为不同的代码级结果处理,只有少量的修复弹. Stock Bench(Stock Bench, )评价了对一个小种群宇宙的反复顺序决定,并报告了被动持有的引用,而Quant Bench(Quant Bench, )研究的是传统的定量模型,特征集,以及培训种子,而不是LLM研究系统. AlphaForge Bench通过许多短的任务扩展了生成的执行数量,KTD-Fin将交易代理行为与信息访问和归属区分开来. 这些设计促使报告执行状况、财务结果和信息界限。

blocks.en: Evaluating a quantitative benchmark also requires controlling the process that produced the final output. Repeated access to noisy backtests creates opportunities for multiple testing and selection bias ( Bailey et al., 2017 ) . Quant-Arena addresses this requirement through frozen data releases, date-scoped execution, bounded research budgets, bounded interaction feedback, explicit financial conventions, and sealed assessment of one committed strategy. The resulting protocol complements code, factor, and trading-decision benchmarks by connecting raw feature construction and bounded research to the sealed financial outcome of a committed strategy.
blocks.zh: 评价量化基准还需要控制产生最终产出的过程。 反复使用吵闹的反向测试为多重测试和选择偏差创造了机会(Bailey等人,2017年). Quant-Arena通过冻结数据发布、日期范围的执行、有限度的研究预算、有限度的互动反馈、明确的财务公约以及对一项已承诺的战略进行密封评估来满足这一要求。 由此产生的协议通过将原始地物构造和定界研究与承诺战略的密封财务结果联系起来,补充了代码、要素和贸易决策基准。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Quant-Arena evaluates a complete quantitative research run, from constructing features on raw market observations to revising candidates and committing one strategy for sealed financial assessment. A shared stock-scoring interface, portfolio rule, and cash-account evaluator connect model-authored research to comparable simulated outcomes.
blocks.zh: Quant-Arena对一项完整的定量研究进行评价,从在原始市场观察上建立特征到修订候选人和执行一项密封财务评估战略。 共享的股票评分界面、投资组合规则和现金账户评价员将模型授权的研究与可比模拟结果联系起来。

blocks.en: Across 38 iterative configurations, the best model scores 51.3 against 77.6 for Kepler-1, a proprietary strategy developed by Einsia AI, and only one configuration, Sol at medium effort, beats the equal-weight market. Pairing each model’s best iterative and one-shot configurations, iteration raises the overall score for all nine models but sealed-period ARR for only four. Decile returns show why: most models rank stocks with some skill, yet the top-ranked names that the portfolio buys earn less than middle-ranked ones, so an average predictive correlation is insufficient to judge an investable strategy. The best-performing Astra configuration profits mainly by staying in cash during the early-2024 decline, which lowers drawdown without beating the market. Candidate trajectories show that research progress comes early and plateaus, and the effort sweep shows that a higher reasoning setting does not consistently improve the result. Together, these findings support evaluating quantitative research through both its development process and the financial outcome of its committed strategy.
blocks.zh: 在38个迭代配置中,最佳模型对开普勒-1的51.3分比77.6分,这是Einsia AI开发的专有策略,只有一个配置Sol在中等努力下战胜了等重市场. 为每个模型最好的迭代和一发配置配对,迭代提高了所有9个模型的总体得分,但封存期ARR只有4个。 十进制回报显示原因:大多数模型排名股票有一定技能,然而投资组合购买的排名最高的名次收入低于排名中等的名次,因此平均预测相关性不足以判断一个可投资策略. 表现最佳的Astra配置主要通过在2024年初的衰退期间保持现金收入而获得利润,这降低了提成而不打击市场. 候选轨迹显示研究进展早到,高原高原,努力扫荡显示,更高的推理设置并不能持续改善结果. 这些调查结果共同支持通过发展进程和所承诺的战略的财务结果评价定量研究。

blocks.en: Appendix B One-Shot Results and Matched-Effort Comparison

blocks.en: B.1 One-Shot Results Across Reasoning Efforts
blocks.zh: B.1 各种理性努力的一热结果

blocks.en: Table 5 : One-shot results for every model and supported reasoning effort, Layout and shading follow Table 2 ; shaded rows mark each model’s highest-scoring one-shot effort. The one-shot setting receives no performance feedback.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个模型的一击结果以及支持的推理努力、布局和阴影都跟随表2;阴影线标记每个模型最高的一击努力。 一拍设定没有收到性能反馈.

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the 38 one-shot runs in the layout of Table 2 . The median configuration scores 31.61, and 4 of the 38 exceed 40 points, against 21 in the iterative setting. Six configurations have positive sealed-period ARR, and none exceeds the 17.1% market.
blocks.zh: 表5按表2的布局报告38次一弹一弹。 中位配置分数为31.61分,38分中的4分超过40分,而在迭代设置中则为21分. 6个配置有正封期ARR,无一个超过17.1%的市场.

blocks.en: Without feedback, reasoning effort is just as inconsistent as with it. For eight of the nine models the best effort is not the highest one supported (Table 5 ). Terra scores 42.14 with no reasoning and 20.98 at max, a 21.16-point range that exceeds every iterative range, and Sol is best at low (32.15) and lowest at max (22.31). Only DeepSeek rises with effort, from 20.48 with no reasoning to 29.92 at max. With no feedback loop to correct a poor draft, each cell reflects a single draft, so the scores swing more with effort.
blocks.zh: 没有反馈,推理努力就和它一样不一致. 对于9个模式中的8个模式,最佳努力不是所支持的最高努力(表5)。 Terra得分42.14分,没有推理,20.98分最高,21.16分的射程超过每个迭代射程,Sol最好低分(32.15分),最低最高分(22.31. 只有DeepSeek努力崛起,从没有推理的20.48上升到最大时的29.92. 由于没有反馈回路来纠正一个差的草稿,每个单元格都反映一个草稿,所以分数会随着努力而波动更大.

blocks.en: B.2 Matched-Effort Comparison
blocks.zh: B.2 匹配工作比较

blocks.en: Iteration helps at matched efforts as well. At each model’s highest supported effort (Gemini: high; others: max), the iterative run outscores the one-shot run for all nine models, with mean scores of 40.88 against 30.18, and has the higher ARR in six of the nine pairs. Across all 38 matched model–effort cells, the iterative run has the higher score in 34, the higher ARR in 26, and the higher RankIC in 28. Matching efforts gives a larger gap than pairing best configurations (Table 3 ) because one-shot scores fall with effort more often, so a one-shot run at max effort is rarely its model’s best.
blocks.zh: 迭接也有助于配合努力。 在每一个模型的最高支持努力(Gemini: high; others: max)中,迭代跑得分超过所有9个模型的一发跑,平均分40.88比30.18,在9对中,有6对的ARR更高. 在所有38个匹配的模型-努力细胞中,迭代运行的得分在34分中较高,在26分中较高ARR,在28分中较高RankIC. 相匹配的努力比配对最佳配置(表3)差距更大,因为一发的分数往往随努力而下降,因此一发的分数以最大努力计算很少是其模式的最佳。

blocks.en: C.1 Signal Similarity and Portfolio Overlap
blocks.zh: C.1 信号相似性和重叠组合

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Pairwise mean daily Spearman signal correlations (a) and Top-75 Jaccard overlaps (b) among the nine models’ best iterative configurations in 2024 (36 pairs). Portfolio overlap measures the selected score sets, rather than identical realized trades under execution constraints.
blocks.zh: 图8:Pairwise指每日Spearman信号关联(a)和Top-75 Jacard在2024年的9种模型最佳迭代配置(36对)中重叠(b). 组合重叠衡量选定得分组合,而不是执行限制下的相同已实现交易。

blocks.en: The mean pairwise rank correlation is 0.47, while mean Top-75 Jaccard overlap is only 6.1% and its maximum is 35.6% (Figure 8 ). Broadly similar rankings therefore need not select the same extreme tail. Opus and DeepSeek are the most similar pair, with correlation 0.94 and overlap 35.6%, followed by Sol–GLM (0.87) and Sonnet–Astra (0.84). Terra is the most distinct strategy, with a mean correlation of 0.14 against the other eight.
blocks.zh: 平均对等等级相关性为0.47,平均为Top-75 Jacard重叠率仅为6.1%,最高为35.6%(图8 )。 因此,大致相似的排名不需要选择相同的极端尾巴. Opus和DeepSeek是最相似的对子,其相关性为0.94,重叠率为35.6%,其次是Sol–GLM(0.87)和Sonnet–Astra(0.84). Terra是最独特的策略,其平均相关性为0.14相对于其他8种.

blocks.en: Opus and DeepSeek are close to each other and correlate at about 0.5 or less with every other model. This agrees with the shared tilt toward higher volatility and turnover in Figure 6 . The remaining models largely form one cluster of related signals.
blocks.zh: Opus和DeepSeek彼此关系密切,在0.5左右与所有其他模型相关. 这与图6中共同倾向于提高波动性和更替率是一致的。 其余的模型基本构成一组相关信号.
